testCases.explanation: This test only verifies that the wallet balance increases after a top-up of SGD 500. It does not verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation (fx_lock), nor does it check that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval). The test misses assertions on the order of operations and the locking of FX rate, and it does not test the rollback behavior on payment provider timeout. A concrete missed assertion is verifying that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited. A concrete bug this test would miss is if the system debits the funding source before crediting the wallet, or if the FX rate changes after initiation, or if top-ups above SGD 10,000 proceed without second-owner approval.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at the moment top-up is initiated
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Verify top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
testCases.hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: If the system debits the funding source before crediting the wallet, this test would not detect it because it only checks the wallet balance increase and not the debit timing. Also, if the FX rate is not locked at initiation and changes during the transaction, this test would not catch it. Furthermore, if a top-up above SGD 10,000 is processed without second-owner approval, this test would not detect that either.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up with FX rate lock, credit-before-debit order, and dual approval for large amounts

suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; transaction rolls back if payment provider callback times out after 5 seconds
